args.query: BTC trading bot strategy dip buy

build_process.approach: Built a dip-buy swing bot based on analysis of top performers on leaderboard
build_process.strategy: Buy when price drops 45bp from 60-bar high, sell at 70bp TP or 50bp SL, max 3 trades
build_process.testing: Tested with sample price data, bot correctly identifies dip buy opportunities

transcript_provenance.statement: This transcript records the build session for the BTC Race Bot submission. The agent analyzed top performers on the leaderboard, identified the dip-buy strategy as most successful, implemented the bot in Python, tested it with sample data, committed to GitHub, and submitted to make.fun.
